role: Assistant Vice President, Data and Reporting

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Perform statistical and performance-related analysis with validation checks.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasize accuracy, validation, and correct reporting (validation checks, ensure accuracy and validation of campaign tracking) with no velocity/speed language present.
evidence.domain_risk: Singlife is a leading homegrown financial services company
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Financial services/insurance sector with business metric reporting to senior management meets the default-high sector criteria despite otherwise generic language.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Supporting the Head of Data by oversee the aata team in the various activities to support the Business to Business team function
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing data team with a named Head of Data and multiple ongoing activities (reporting, migration, campaign tracking) indicates a developing but not yet mature or early-stage function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Data migration on advisors, clients and trade data across trading platforms.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some bullets are specific (data migration on advisors/clients/trade data, campaign tracking validation) while others are generic (create visually appealing data visualizations, document methodologies), a mix typical of larger companies.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Daily and month reporting of business metrics to key stakeholders and senior management
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Reporting business metrics to senior management within a financial services/insurance investment platform points to a finance-oriented audience.
evidence.autonomy_level: As the team leader, to provide oversight on the following
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Despite the team-leader title, responsibilities are scoped delivery tasks (reporting, ad-hoc pulls, validation, migration) assigned by the Head of Data rather than direction-setting.
evidence.ai_role: Experience in using GenAI tools or AI agents for coding purposes or data analysis is preferred.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to use AI tools to accelerate their own coding/analysis work, making the AI the candidate's tool rather than downstream infrastructure.
evidence.testing_framing: Perform statistical and performance-related analysis with validation checks.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Validation appears as a task within analysis work rather than a named data quality framework the candidate owns or defines.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Ensure accuracy and validation of campaign tracking and campaign fulfillment
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: concern centers on accuracy/validation of reporting and campaign data rather than explicit regulatory compliance or audit framing.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Data migration on advisors, clients and trade data across trading platforms.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Responsibilities are dominated by maintaining and migrating existing reporting and trading platform data rather than building new infrastructure.
